snippet.title: Should You Try FATAL CORE 🤔? - An overview and review of this new TCG!
snippet.description:
I was approached by Fatal Core to do a Sponsored video giving my honest review and overview of the game and let you all know what I think. This is a really unique card game that has a very interesting gameplay system. In this video I go over the basics of how the game works and its core mechanics as well as an overview of the economy and my closing thoughts.

► Play the game here -  https://fatalcoretcg.com/
► The fatal core discord: https://discord.gg/augzm4n

Intro : 00:00
What Is Fatal Core? 00:30
Gameplay Basics - 02:04
How Deckbuilding Works - 06:58
How To Get More Cards - 09:27
Should You Try Fatal Core - 10:47

Thank you so much to the awesome folks at Fatal Core for sponsoring this video and letting me check out their game!

Music by Harris Heller: 
https://www.streambeats.com/
